item.name: Sailor
item.buffs: Faster top speed on all boats and better boat handling. Some guides also note a small hunger reduction.
item.cardSummary: Cheapest class for sailing faster between islands when you only need a boat speed boost.

item.name: Survivor
item.buffs: Faster health regeneration, extra oxygen, and reduced hunger drain.
item.cardSummary: Budget sustain pick that softens early hunger, oxygen, and regen pressure while you learn the raft loop.

item.name: Medic
item.buffs: Faster health regeneration and a healing-focused starter kit.
item.cardSummary: Low-cost support class that starts with a Medkit for recovery on early runs and co-op play.

item.name: Crewmate
item.buffs: Starts with a Flintlock and a small gun damage bonus (about +10%).
item.cardSummary: Cheapest ranged combat unlock when you want a pistol and a light gun-damage edge from day one.

item.name: Camper
item.buffs: Starts with a Good Sack and about +10% health.
item.cardSummary: Starter utility class that adds a better sack and a modest health bump for early island trips.

item.name: Builderman
item.buffs: Cheaper crafting and higher structure health (about +25% each on base kit reports).
item.cardSummary: Budget builder class for raft crafting discounts and tougher structures in team base setups.

item.name: Chef
item.buffs: Starts with a Burger Stand that produces healing food, plus reduced hunger and extra health.
item.cardSummary: Food-focused support class that helps keep the crew fed and healed on longer raft sessions.

item.name: Merchant
item.buffs: Starts with extra Doubloons and gains a permanent Doubloon bonus for shop and merchant spends.
item.cardSummary: Economy class for players who want more Doubloons early to buy gear and services faster.

item.name: Adventurer
item.buffs: Starts with a Giant Sack plus higher health and reduced hunger for longer island runs.
item.cardSummary: Budget explorer loadout that carries more loot and stays healthier while scavenging islands.

item.name: Harpooner
item.buffs: Starts with the Riptide weapon and a sprint speed bonus for budget ranged pressure.
item.cardSummary: Low-cost ranged option built around the Riptide harpoon-style weapon and extra sprint.

item.name: Swordsman
item.buffs: Strong melee damage bonus with extra health for close-range fighting.
item.cardSummary: Affordable melee class that starts with a Machete and leans into high melee damage early.

item.name: Olympian
item.buffs: Much faster sprint speed with a solid max-health bonus. No dedicated starter weapon.
item.cardSummary: Mid-cost mobility class for faster island movement and tankier body stats without a combat starter.

item.name: Battle Buku
item.buffs: Melee damage bonus plus a MukuMuku shop discount with a unique Poku Poku starter.
item.cardSummary: Mid-cost melee pick that mixes a special starter weapon with market discount value.

item.name: Soldier
item.buffs: Starts with an Assault Rifle and ammo, plus faster sprint for mobile gunfights.
item.cardSummary: Mid-cost gun class that hands you an Assault Rifle immediately for night raids and island fights.

item.name: Cowboy
item.buffs: Starts with a Revolver, extra health, and a strong gun damage bonus.
item.cardSummary: Revolver-focused mid-cost class for players who want gun damage and a health cushion.

item.name: Zookeeper
item.buffs: Greatly amplifies companion power so pet bonuses hit much harder.
item.cardSummary: Companion-focused class for runs built around strong pets rather than personal combat kits.

item.name: Knight
item.buffs: Claymore starter with Knight Armor damage reduction (about 30%), plus sprint speed.
item.cardSummary: Durable mid-cost tank that starts armored for melee pressure and safer island fights.

item.name: Sharpshooter
item.buffs: High gun damage and faster reload for pistol-style ranged combat.
item.cardSummary: Advanced gun class that boosts Flintlock damage and reload for steady ranged pressure.

item.name: Millionaire
item.buffs: Spawns with a Jumbo Luxury Yacht and a large Doubloon bank, plus a small health bonus.
item.cardSummary: Advanced economy class that starts rich and on a luxury yacht for faster early shopping and travel.

item.name: Alien Warrior
item.buffs: Energy Sword starter with Alien Armor damage reduction and higher max health for melee tanking.
item.cardSummary: Advanced melee tank that trades into armored close combat with an Energy Sword.

item.name: Pirate
item.buffs: Starts with a Blunderbuss, strong gun damage, and improved boat handling or speed.
item.cardSummary: Advanced pirate loadout for shotgun-style gun damage while still improving boat travel.

item.name: Treasure Hunter
item.buffs: Extra sack slots, starting Doubloons, and a permanent Doubloon bonus for loot-heavy runs.
item.cardSummary: Advanced looting class for maximum carry space and Doubloon gains while scavenging islands.

item.name: Hero
item.buffs: Holy Sword starter with high health and reduced hunger for durable melee play.
item.cardSummary: Premium melee class that starts with the Holy Sword and strong sustain for aggressive close fights.

item.name: Battle Bunny
item.buffs: Double jump, faster sprint, and Egg Grenades gained from enemies and chests.
item.cardSummary: Premium mobility class for double-jump movement and explosive Egg Grenade pressure.

item.name: Fire Mage
item.buffs: Starts with a Magma Staff and a large magic damage bonus for top-end DPS.
item.cardSummary: Top-cost magic class built around Magma Staff damage for clearing enemies quickly.

item.name: Ice Mage
item.buffs: Starts with an Ice Staff and strong magic damage, with later sprint value as the class levels.
item.cardSummary: Premium magic alternative to Fire Mage that pairs Ice Staff damage with mobility as it levels.

item.name: Ancient Squid
item.buffs: Starts with the Squid Laser Gun plus sprint speed, with health and laser upgrades as it levels.
item.cardSummary: Premium laser class that combines a powerful starter gun with mobility and late laser reliability.

item.name: Alien Overlord
item.buffs: Starts with a Ray Gun and a UFO ship for fast ocean and island travel, with weapon cooldown and ship speed upgrades later.
item.cardSummary: Premium exploration-combat class that pairs a Ray Gun with a UFO for the fastest map coverage.

item.name: Raider
item.buffs: Dual Pistols with ammo growth every few kills, ammo drops from kills, and faster sprint.
item.cardSummary: Premium dual-pistol class that sustains ammo through kills and stays mobile in long fights.
